docs.summary: Inspector for a [`Sprite`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Sprite) sub-asset: a preview of its sub-rect in the source texture, its read-only stats, and a button to edit the texture's sprites in the Sprite Editor. Sprites aren't edited here - they're configured on their source texture (Sprite Mode + Sprite Editor).
